newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 15.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to watch - July 15.

text.p: -- Chipmaker Intel Corp is due to report second quarter results after the market close. The First Call consensus earnings estimate is $0.90 per share, compared to $0.59 a year earlier. Intel's stock closed at 78-12/16 Monday.

-- Citicorp posted second quarter earnings of $2.10 per diluted share, up from $1.86 a year ago and compared with a First Call consensus estimate of $2.09. Adjusted revenues rose to $5.75 billion from $5.32 billion a year ago. The stock closed at 128-5/8.
-- Texas Instruments posted second quarter operating earnings of $1.07 per share, compared with $0.21 a year ago. Revenues rose to $2.56 billion from $2.40 billion. The stock closed at 97-1/2.
-- Hertz Corp reported second quarter earnings of $0.50 per share, up from $0.36 a year ago. It said its chief financial officer, William Sider, would retire in 1998. The stock finished at 38-13/16.

-- SDL Inc said it expected a second quarter net loss of $30 million after one-time charges. Revenues will be about the same as the $21.6 million of a year ago, it said, because of a longer-than-anticipated qualification process by some customers for one of its pump modules. The stock closed at 19-1/2.
